title: Clean default WhatsApp links with optional prefilled messages

requirements.summary: Make default WhatsApp CTA generate a clean wa.me link while preserving optional message support using CONTACT_CONFIG.whatsappPhone.
acceptanceCriteria: When no message is provided, WhatsApp links resolve to the clean format `https://wa.me/<number>` with no `?text=` query string.
When a message is explicitly provided (e.g., property-specific inquiry), the link includes a `?text=` query string with proper URL encoding.
All WhatsApp links continue to use the centralized `CONTACT_CONFIG.whatsappPhone` number.

file_operations.description: Update generateWhatsAppLink(message?) to return `https://wa.me/<CONTACT_CONFIG.whatsappPhone>` when message is undefined/empty, and only append a URL-encoded `?text=` query when a non-empty message is explicitly provided. Keep phone number sourcing centralized via CONTACT_CONFIG.whatsappPhone.

requirements.summary: Update all WhatsApp CTA entry points that relied on the previous default-message behavior to use the new clean default link behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the floating WhatsApp button opens WhatsApp using the clean `wa.me/<number>` link (no prefilled message).
Any CTA that previously called `generateWhatsAppLink()` with no arguments now opens WhatsApp using the clean link.
Property/project-specific CTAs that intentionally include context may still open with a prefilled message (short and readable), using the message-enabled link generation path.

file_operations.description: Ensure the floating WhatsApp button continues calling generateWhatsAppLink() with no arguments so it opens the new clean wa.me link (no prefilled message).

Verify the project-specific WhatsApp CTA continues to pass an explicit, short, readable context message into generateWhatsAppLink(message) so it uses the message-enabled link path (and remains properly URL-encoded).
